card.title: 10th RECON

card.flavorText: The 10th Recon Regiment joined the Imperial Japanese Army’s 10th Division during its reorganization in 1940. The division, known as the "Iron Division," had a long history but was redirected to garrison duties in Manchukuo that year. Stationed in Jiamusi under the Kwantung Army, it guarded the Soviet border and took part in anti-partisan operations. In 1944, the division was reassigned as Japan shifted to a defensive stance in the Pacific. The 10th Division was originally slated for deployment to Taiwan but was redirected to the Philippines. On Luzon, it came under the Japanese Fourteenth Area Army and faced devastating losses during the US invasion. Its 39th Infantry Regiment distinguished itself in fierce combat, but the division was largely destroyed. Survivors fought on in guerrilla operations until Japan’s surrender in 1945, though disease and starvation took a greater toll than battle.
